verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a management API for programmatically creating and controlling flags and experiments one at a time, usable from scripts or CI. Nothing documents a native bulk operation, such as a batch endpoint or multi-select bulk edit, archive or rollout across many items at once. Scripting a loop over the API is a developer building block, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
